narr: The center of Tropical Storm Elsa tracked north just inland of the Middle Atlantic Coast from Thursday morning through Thursday night, July 8th. The Tropical Storm produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and south central Virginia, and the Virginia Northern Neck.
ev: Numerous roads were closed or washed out due to high water across the northwest part of the county, including Crymes Road, Kings Road, and Falls Road.
Stranded vehicles in high water were reported on West Hundred Road and Jefferson Davis Highway. One water rescue was performed.
Car was stranded due to high water.

Chester Road at Perrymont Road was closed due to high water.
Nearly 70 percent of all roads in Petersburg were closed due to flooding at the height of the event.
High water was over Rives Road.
Water was covering the intersection of Woods Edge Road and Ruffin Mill Road.
Boydton Plank Road at Franklin Street was closed due to high water.
Cattail Road at Barnetts Road was closed due to high water.
